versions.changelog: No file changes detected. This is a metadata-only version update; there are no functional changes in this release.

Initial release of fulcra-workspaces.

- Enables agents to collaborate via persistent, versioned Fulcra workspaces.
- Supports shared team directories for OKF-compliant coordination and communication.
- Allows uploading and managing user artifacts and team deliverables with explicit user approval.
- Provides structured team inboxes, role documentation, and progress tracking for both teams and individual agents.
- Includes mechanisms for secure, authorized cross-agent data sharing and efficient activity monitoring.
